scope: Independent review of the four assigned candidate/reference pairs only.

identity.hash_method: PowerShell Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 on the unmodified original PNG bytes.
identity.scale_comparison: Candidate 930x1240 at logical 1x; reference 1860x2480 at physical 2x. Geometry was compared at the same logical scale.
identity.reference_bundle_note: The bundle hash is supplied review context; this four-pair review independently hashed only the eight assigned PNG files.

observations: The candidate visibly opens with the reader menu, consistent with menu=true in the matching case metadata.
The integrated header is approximately 78 logical pixels high. The book/chapter text, back arrow, bookmark, bullet-list table-of-contents action and time/battery group remain distinct and unclipped.
The bottom menu begins at approximately logical y=1031, with 48-pixel side insets for progress and chapter controls and a 76-pixel tool row. Its placement agrees with the normalized reference.

The remaining-page text, current/total page numbers, progress handle, both chapter navigation labels and all five tool labels are readable. The space between the chapter navigation buttons contains no stray horizontal rules.
The More tool displays a three-dot ellipsis, and the header table-of-contents action has separate bullets and approximately 20-pixel-wide list geometry.
Typography preserves a bold chapter heading and quieter supporting text. Controls and separators use neutral grayscale, with no visible tint, overlap or clipped glyphs.
intentional_differences: Artwork composition and its internal margins differ from the reference. These content differences alone are not evidence of an application viewport inset.

observations: The candidate is a pure artwork scene. No application header, bookmark ribbon, footer page number, tool row or notification is visible.
The case metadata records menu=false, no modal, no reader panel and show_tap_zones=false. The visible capture agrees with the closed-reader state.
The reference visibly contains a bookmark ribbon and a centered footer page number. Their absence in the candidate follows the explicit artwork-only override.
The same candidate PNG bytes are used by the fullscreen case, consistent with both aliases rendering the same overridden closed-reader scene.
intentional_differences: The reference footer and persistent bookmark ribbon are intentionally absent under the user override.
Artwork composition, cropping and artwork-internal margins may differ. No viewport-inset finding is inferred from those differences.

observations: The candidate visibly contains artwork only. It has no application header, footer, bookmark ribbon, notification or tool row.
The case metadata records menu=false and no active modal or reader panel, consistent with the observed closed-reader scene.
The reference bookmark ribbon is visible at its upper right, while the candidate omits it as explicitly required.
The artwork reaches the top and bottom of the native candidate capture. Differences in the pictured panels and artwork-internal white margins do not establish an application viewport defect.
intentional_differences: The persistent reference bookmark ribbon is intentionally absent under the user override.
Artwork composition and cropping differ from the reference and were not treated as application-decoration defects.

observations: The image settings sheet is visibly open above the progress area, with the Image tool selected and the reader menu retained. Metadata records menu=true and reader_panel=picture.

The sheet begins at approximately logical y=778 and fits above the unchanged lower menu. Its actual artwork preview, heading, contrast controls, refresh choices, dither row and night switch are all visible without clipping.
The contrast control shows five positions with the standard state selected, plus distinct minus and plus buttons. Refresh choices are every page, 3, 6, 10 and chapter change, with 6 visibly selected.

The sixteen-level grayscale dither switch is on and the night switch is off. The dither wording does not claim qualified hardware dithering, consistent with metadata declaring software_dither=true and hardware_dither_qualified=false.

The sheet preserves the reference's two-column control organization and 48-pixel outer inset at the normalized logical scale. Neutral gray separators and unselected outlines remain legible against white.

The chapter navigation row is free of stray rules, the More icon is a three-dot ellipsis, and the top table-of-contents action retains distinct bullet-list geometry at approximately 20 logical pixels wide.
intentional_differences: The preview shows the candidate's actual artwork rather than the reference's differently composed crop.

The reference hardware-dither status is replaced by the implemented sixteen-level grayscale dither control. The supplied capability declaration supports software dithering and does not qualify hardware dithering.

prior_finding_rechecks.observation: Both viewed menu states show a compact three-dot ellipsis above the More label, consistent with the reference action.

Both viewed menu states leave clean white space between the previous/next chapter buttons. No stray horizontal rules cross that navigation row; the progress track above and toolbar boundary below remain separate.
The header table-of-contents action in both viewed states is a bullet-list icon with separate bullets and lines, approximately 20 logical pixels wide, rather than a tiny three-line glyph.

limitations: This review covers only the four assigned reference pairs and makes no claim that the complete round is clean.

All eight assigned original PNGs were individually displayed with tools.view_image. The viewer downsampled the 1860x2480 reference images for display; comparisons used the documented 2x reference scale.

No application, build, test suite, runtime probe, Git operation or product modification was performed. Work was limited to reading the assigned JSON/PNG evidence, hashing the PNG bytes and writing this review document.
Static screenshots establish visible state and clipping only. They do not prove pointer reachability, interaction behavior or the absence of an invisible footer-cycle hit region.
The two-column six-row table-of-contents panel is not open in these assigned captures, so its row dimensions and spacing are not evaluated here.
Unsupported pen, sensor, qualified hardware-dither and external-authorization behavior cannot be validated from these static reader states.
